renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-motivation shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the approved named guardian pair or canonical internal pair, never a third guardian, unseen coworker, manager, client, recipient, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying someone else. Use every named guardian's canonical element sheet; preserve identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Pair plus focal shared-work device covers 55–65% and reads at actual width 80px. Show two visible roles and a reversible division of work without hierarchy, guaranteed performance, promotion, applause, delivery, consensus, harvest, product success or completed outcome. Every knob, screw, tray, wedge, tab, tile, divider, token, clip, lock, band, peg, clamp, selector or tag remains removable, half-set, unlatched, blank or not yet applied. Symbols and isolated geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Keep each composition distinct in camera axis, dominant silhouette, role separation, handoff boundary and open negative-space shape. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart, closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
